originality.rationale: Compared exact implications with published Zhu–Wu all-trinomial and gap theorem, its global trinomial count, Cheng global sparse classification and Graner universal factorization; none inspected states the exact 18-layer coefficient-weight table or the mixed-layer 1:4:7 law. Generic factorization can in principle calculate this finite result, so implicit priority is a documented risk, not excluded by absence of a search hit.
residual_risks: Any generic factorization formula can in principle produce the entire finite table algorithmically; an earlier table or implicit special-case derivation may have been overlooked.

value.rationale: This completes a naturally defined coefficient-weight classification for every quartic cyclotomic layer over GF8, the first characteristic-two field with non-all-trinomial quartic layers admitting trinomials. It resolves the degree-four local distribution question left open by an all-or-none sparsity theorem and the gap inequality, distinguishing exact 1:4:7 mixed layers from fourteen no-trinomial layers. This natural finite classification, including all 1008 irreducible quartics, is mathematically motivated; no broader general-field claim is inferred.
